frontmatter.title: Baseball Hall of Fame Decision Tree Classifier

node.html: Processed data from the Lahman Baseball Database using SQL and developed a decision tree classifier in Python to predict players eligible for nomination or induction into the Baseball Hall of Fame.
Built a temperature probe connected to a web application that shared real-time temperature data from the kitchens of home cooks, allowing potential customers to monitor kitchen conditions.
Designed a hardware implementation of the I-BERT transformer model on the PYNQ-Z1 FPGA board.
Implemented a real-time operating system in C on an STM32 Nucleo board, featuring context switching, dynamic memory management, and round-robin/earliest deadline first (EDF) task scheduling.
Designed a software communication protocol between a C2000 microcontroller and a Raspberry Pi, implementing error detection, reliable message delivery, and priority-based messaging.
Designed a miniature reservoir system prototype for irrigation, using a depth sensor, servo motor, and DC motor to regulate water tank input and output across multiple irrigation zones.

Developed a multithreaded C application to crawl a web server and concatenate PNG slices. Implemented mutexes, semaphores, and the producer-consumer design pattern to ensure proper thread synchronization and efficient processing.

frontmatter.title: Toyota Innovation Challenge Sticker Quality Detector

node.html: Developed a real-time visual inspection system using OpenCV, Python, and the YOLO machine learning model to assess the quality of robotic sticker applications.
Created a Python web scraping script that uses multithreading to compile a spreadsheet with financial data for Canadian stocks from the Wall Street Journal website.
Built a React web application to track natural events, integrating Leaflet's mapping engine and event data from NASA's EONET API for real-time updates and visualization.
Developed a 2D retro-style, two-player spaceship shooting game, incorporating sound effects, keyboard controls, and object-oriented programming principles for efficient game design.
Programmed an STM32 ARM microcontroller in C to transmit and receive Morse code messages using button input and an LED.
Recreated a single-player Minesweeper game with customizable board size and bomb density.
